title: Prepositions of movement
en:
Movement: across (from one side to the other), along (following a line), through (inside, from one end to the other), into / out of, up / down, over / under, past (go by something), towards (in the direction of), round / around.

Walk across the bridge. Drive along the river. Go through the gate. Get into the car / out of the car. Go past the canteen and turn left.

Giving directions: Go up the stairs, walk along the corridor, go past the lift, the office is on the right.
ru: Предлоги движения: across — через (поперёк), along — вдоль, through — сквозь, into — внутрь, out of — изнутри наружу, up / down — вверх / вниз, over — над / через, under — под, past — мимо, towards — по направлению к, round — вокруг.

boss.situation: Describe the route from your office entrance to your desk or to a meeting room.
samples: Go through the main gate and walk past the security office.
Go into the building and up the stairs to the second floor.
Walk along the corridor towards the windows.
Go past the kitchen and the meeting room.
My office is the last door on the left.

qs.q: Walk ___ the bridge to the other side of the river.
qs.exp: From one side to the other → across.

qs.q: The train went ___ the tunnel.
We walked ___ the river for an hour.
He got ___ the car and drove away.
Go ___ the bank and turn right.
The cat jumped ___ the fence.
She ran ___ the stairs to the fifth floor.
Get ___ of the building — it's a fire alarm!
“Past” in “Go past the canteen” means you go by it, not into it.
“Along the river” means from one side of the river to the other.
qs.exp: That is across; along = following the river.

qs.q: The car drove ___ the tunnel.
Walk ___ the corridor to the end.
He jumped ___ the swimming pool.
Go ___ the stairs to the basement.
A man was walking ___ us, so we stopped.
The plane flew ___ the mountains.
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: go through the gate and turn left

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: walk along the corridor to the end

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the office is past the meeting room

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she got out of the taxi

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: go up the stairs to the second floor

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Go passed the bank.”
Correct the mistake: “He went in the room.”
Correct the mistake: “We walked across the river for an hour, enjoying the view.”
a: We walked along the river for an hour, enjoying the view.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She came out from the office.”
a: She came out of the office.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The train went across the tunnel.”
a: The train went through the tunnel.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He ran to up the hill.”
Пройдите через проходную и поверните налево.
a: Go through the gate and turn left.
Go through the checkpoint and turn left.
Walk through the gate and turn left.
Go through the entrance and turn left.

qs.q: Идите вдоль коридора.
Пройдите мимо столовой.
Поднимитесь по лестнице на третий этаж.
a: Go up the stairs to the third floor.
Walk up the stairs to the third floor.

qs.q: Мы перешли через дорогу.
Он вышел из машины.
a: He got out of the car.

qs.q: Поезд проехал через туннель.
a: The train went through the tunnel.
The train passed through the tunnel.

qs.q: Она шла к нам.
